result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, cutting off mid-word ('Piccolo' or similar full name). While horizontal clipping at the edge is expected, this card appears to be almost fully visible yet the text is still clipped, suggesting the text truncation is not handled gracefully.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a defined max-width to restaurant name labels so truncated names show an ellipsis rather than cutting off mid-word.
